title: Turkish Sausage Menemen
description: A classic Turkish-inspired breakfast dish made with juicy sausages, turkish ingredients, and a hint of spice.

ingredients.name: Turkish Sausages
ingredients.notes: you can use any type of sausage you like

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it starts to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook for another 3-4 minutes, until it starts to soften.
Add the chopped tomato and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the Turkish sausages to the skillet and cook, breaking them up with a spoon, until they are no longer pink and the onions are tender.
Season the mixture with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
